LanguageData.RT_T80BVM_MainBattleTank.label: T-80BVM
LanguageData.RT_T80BVM_MainBattleTank.description:
Modernized Russian gas-turbine MBT with Relikt ERA, 125mm 2A46M-4 cannon, Kord 12.7mm heavy MG, and PKT MG.
<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1, Commander x1, Gunner x1 <color=#bb8f04>Fuel:</color> Chemfuel
<color=#b0e0e6>CE Ammo:</color> - 125mm 2A46M-4 Cannon: 125mm 3OF26 (HE), 125mm 3BK18M (HEAT), 125mm 3BM60 (APFSDS) - 12.7mm Kord Heavy MG: 12.7x108mm cartridge (FMJ / AP / HE / Sabot) - 7.62mm Coaxial PKT MG: 7.62x54mmR cartridge (FMJ / AP / HP)
